2608.05806.title: Hierarchical Latent Prediction for Language Models
2608.05806.paper_summary: While standard Next-Token Prediction (NTP) lays the foundation of language model pre- training, its teacher-forced training paradigm may not be optimal for long-horizon reasoning and planning. Recent works such as Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) and Next-Latent prediction (NextLat) try to mitigate the problem through predicting multiple future tokens and self-supervised prediction in the latent space. However, those auxiliary objectives either have a limited horizon or suffer from compounding error from multi-step rollout. We introduce Hierarchical Latent Prediction (HiLP), which introduces an auxiliary higher-level abstract latent to help reduce the error accumulation effect in latent-space rollouts. Experiments show that HiLP can lead to longer-horizon coherent belief state representation and demonstrate the effectiveness of our method across coding and multi-step reasoning benchmarks, and offers more speculative decoding efficiency.
2608.05806.paper_summary_zh: 雖然標準的下一個標記預測（NTP）為語言模型的預訓練奠定了基礎，但其教師強制訓練範式可能不適合長期推理和規劃。最近的研究，如多標記預測（MTP）和下一潛在預測（NextLat），試圖通過預測多個未來標記和在潛在空間中的自我監督預測來緩解這個問題。然而，這些輔助目標要麼具有有限的視野，要麼因多步展開而遭受累積錯誤。我們提出了層次潛在預測（HiLP），它引入了一個輔助的高層次抽象潛在，以幫助減少潛在空間展開中的錯誤累積效應。實驗表明，HiLP可以導致更長視野的連貫信念狀態表示，並展示我們的方法在編碼和多步推理基準測試中的有效性，並提供更具投機性的解碼效率。
